description: The plot illustrates the ratio of loss values of different methods to that of Vanilla with respect to FLOPs. The x-axis is labeled "FLOPs" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10^16 to 10^19, and has tick labels at intervals of 10^17, 10^18, and 10^19. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains five lines: Vanilla (blue, dashed), StrmLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=128) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=64, H) (purple, solid), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (brown, solid). The Vanilla line starts at approximately 1 and remains steady around 1 across the x-axis. StrmLLM (n=64) starts at around 1.1 and decreases to approximately 0.75. SepLLM (n=64) begins at about 1 and decreases to around 0.8. SepLLM (n=128) starts at roughly 0.9 and decreases to approximately 0.75. SepLLM (n=64, H) begins at around 1 and decreases to about 0.8, while SepLLM (n=64, H/T) starts at approximately 1.1 and decreases to around 0.8. All non-Vanilla lines exhibit a declining trend across the x-axis.
